Class HttpExchange

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.jdk.net.httpserver.HttpExchange
public final class HttpExchange extends Object
The bounded request view for the request currently dispatched by HttpServer.

    • getRequestBody

      public InputStream getRequestBody()
      The request body. Its first 512 bytes arrive with the request; reading past them takes the rest from the client, waiting up to five seconds for it. available() tells how many declared bytes are left to read.

    • getResponseHeaders

      public Headers getResponseHeaders()
      The response headers, to set before sendResponseHeaders(int, long).

    • sendResponseHeaders

      public void sendResponseHeaders(int status, long responseLength) throws IOException
      Sends the status line and headers. A responseLength above zero is sent as Content-Length; zero sends a body of any length that ends when the connection closes, and -1 means no body.
      Throws:
      IOException
